newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ballet director Bruce Marks stepping down.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ballet director Bruce Marks stepping down.

text.p: The Boston Ballet said Saturday its artistic director Bruce Marks would be stepping down this spring at the end of the 1997 season.

Marks, 60, a former principal with the American Ballet Theatre in New York who brought several of his partners including Cynthia Gregory and Violette Verdy to teach at the Boston Ballet, cited personal reasons for his decision, saying he wanted to spend more time with his family.
Anne-Marie Holmes, currently associate artistic director of the company, will assume Marks' role.

Holmes, 53, a Canadian who trained and danced with Russia's Kirov Ballet, and has worked with choreographers suchs as Rudi van Dantzig and Agnes de Mille, will assume the job this summer, a Boston Ballet spokeswoman said.
